page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance running on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, it provides 64 dedicated virtual CPUs and 128 GB of system memory. This establishes a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 2.0 GB of memory per core, targeting environments that require substantial processing capacity without excessive memory allocation.

The instance provides a baseline network throughput of 32 Gbps to support high-volume data movement across cloud services. There is no integrated local storage or discrete GPU hardware included in the hardware profile, requiring persistent data to be maintained via network-attached block storage. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance by default.

From a resource allocation standpoint, maintaining a 1:2 core-to-memory proportion provides cost-effective provisioning by eliminating the expense of surplus RAM in CPU-intensive operations. The ecs.c8i.16xlarge is appropriately configured for workloads such as large-scale batch processing, distributed software compilation, video encoding pipelines, scientific simulations, and high-concurrency web application serving.
